title: Mega Millions Number Watch — Number 69 Has Gone Quiet for 50+ Draws
headline: Number 69 Has Gone Quiet for 50+ Draws

prose.intro: Every so often a number simply stops showing up. In Mega Millions, that number is 69, and it has now missed 50+ consecutive draws.
prose.fact: Before this run, no gap in the 50-draw sample had stretched beyond 37 drawings. Number 69 just moved the ceiling to 50+.
prose.context: Worth saying plainly: none of this makes anything "due". Every drawing starts from scratch, and no gap or pattern carries over. This entry documents an extreme in the dataset — that's all it is.
